Title: Inventory lists complete product cards

[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/
[ACT] Type {{STANDARD_USER}} into 'Username'
[ACT] Type {{USER_PASSWORD}} into 'Password'
[ACT] Click 'Login'
[WAIT] Wait for the Products page
Assertions:
[DOM] 6 product cards visible
[DOM] Each card has name, description, price, image and 'Add to cart'
[TEXT] Every price matches $<digits>.<2 digits>
